When this card deals direct Chi damage to your opponent, search your deck for 1 Palm Trick and add it to your hand.

Pay 2500 Chi to choose 1 Catalyst in your deck with 2000 Counter Pressure or less and Special Spawn it. That Catalyst cannot attack or activate its effects until 3 player turns have been completed after it was spawned. After those 3 turns, send this card to the Void. [Serpent]

After the first turn this card is spawned, this Catalyst may attack your opponent's Chi directly. [Serpent]

The equipped Catalyst gains 800 Pressure. When the equipped Catalyst attacks a Defense Position Catalyst and its Pressure exceeds that Catalyst's Counter Pressure, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. [Reaper]

Pay 1500 Chi to activate this card. This card can only be activated if you have no Catalysts in your hand or on your field. Choose 1 Catalyst in your deck without a printed conditional-spawn restriction and Special Spawn it. Link that Catalyst to this card. When this card is destroyed, remove that linked Catalyst from play.

This card can only be played while "Palm Trick #438" is face-up on either player's field. If "Palm Trick #438" is no longer face-up on the field, destroy this card. Increase the Pressure of all face-up FIRE-Type Catalysts by 1000. [kasaki]

Pay 1000 Chi. Take control of all face-up FIRE-Type Catalysts until the End Phase. [kasaki]

The Catalyst equipped with this card becomes a FIRE-Attribute Catalyst and gains the Vampire sub-type. [Henry1245]

Once per turn, choose and activate only 1 of the following effects: (1) Pay 1000 Chi; choose 1 FIRE-Type Catalyst in your Void and Special Spawn it. [Henry1245]
